fields.columns: | columns event.time, event.type, site.name, agent.uuid, src.process.storyline.id, src.process.user, src.process.uid, src.process.cmdline, src.ip.address, src.port.number, dst.ip.address, dst.port.number, src.process.parent.cmdline, tgt.process.cmdline
fields.description: Detects a certain command line flag combination used by "devinit.exe", which can be abused as a LOLBIN to download arbitrary MSI packages on a Windows system
fields.name: Arbitrary MSI Download Via Devinit.EXE
fields.query: event.type="Process Creation" and (endpoint.os="windows" and (tgt.process.cmdline contains " -t msi-install " and tgt.process.cmdline contains " -i http"))
